scan.selection: Sorted git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard ordinary files. Hash each relative UTF-8 path + NUL + SHA256(file bytes).
scan.exclusionReason: Exclude the report being generated to avoid a self-referential source hash. A subsequent committed-history scan covers this generated provenance file.

limitations: Default Gitleaks rules are heuristic and cannot prove absence of secrets. This source snapshot excludes its own generated evidence file to avoid self-reference; a subsequent committed-history scan covers the final commit, with evidence kept outside source. Ignored build caches and private reports were excluded from the source scan.
cleanup: Downloaded archive, metadata, checksum file and copied source snapshot were removed. Executable and its MIT license remain in ignored .tools for the final scan.
